label: Instagram (Hojat · single-shot)
description: Single-agent Instagram pipeline. Hojat reads the KB, drafts caption + slides + hashtags, picks per-slide design templates, generates Unsplash queries, composes the gpt-image-2 prompts, AND writes natively in the target output language — all in one LLM call. Trade-off vs. the multi-agent `ig` recipe: ~$0.30–0.60 per run (vs ~$1.40), 30–90s (vs 5–8min), one calm voice end-to-end (vs handoff drift), single founder gate (vs Gate A + Gate B). Use Hojat for fast, coherent, brand-consistent posts; use `ig` for high-stakes regulatory posts that need every claim signed off by Daneshyar.
